source.citation: Frances Benjamin Johnston, [Mrs. Fairbanks making address at the laying of the conerstone, Memorial Continental Hall, no. 5], platinum photograph, between 1905 and 1908 (title devised by the Library). Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, Frances Benjamin Johnston Collection, LOT 2910, LC-DIG-ppmsca-39000 (item 2015647074).
what_it_does_not_supply: anything about Chicago, the Glessner household or Frances M. Glessner; no likeness is asserted
what_it_supplies: a matron's day dress of the decade: a dark coat or bodice, a high white collar, a lace jabot at the throat
the large hats of the years, trimmed with plumes and flowers, worn on drawn-up hair
